description: A bright yellow tennis ball is on the tabletop in front of a white cloth backdrop, with both hands held out over the surface. The left hand starts holding the left-hand object (the tennis ball) near the center, then the ball shifts into the right hand as a right-hand object; the right hand repeatedly tosses it upward and slightly left while the left hand opens to receive it, catching and returning it in a short back-and-forth, ending with a throw that sends the ball off to the left.
